# Gorythm Academy

> Built with Signs. Discover Yourself. Online academy for IQ, EQ, and PhQ through structured courses and research.

Gorythm Academy is an initiative of Al-Farhan Institute. Pages below are the public site. Account, admin, and classroom pages are for signed-in users.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gorythmacademy.com/): Academy homepage
- [All courses](https://gorythmacademy.com/courses): Course list
- [About](https://gorythmacademy.com/about): About the academy
- [Research](https://gorythmacademy.com/research): Research articles
- [Contact](https://gorythmacademy.com/contact): Contact and enrollment
- [Privacy](https://gorythmacademy.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://gorythmacademy.com/terms): Terms of service
- [Cookies](https://gorythmacademy.com/cookies): Cookie policy
